prompt: Production game illustration matching medieval illuminated manuscript bestiary art. Fine dark sepia ink contour and hatching, restrained muted pigments, vermilion team-color accents, flat hand-painted tempera, charming strange marginalia. A middle-aged male arcane mage in a full-length deep navy blue and ultramarine robe with silver-grey tidal wave trim along the cuffs and bottom hem, pale parchment-tan skin, dark hair and short beard, wearing a focused slightly smug expression. One hand is raised high holding an ash-grey wooden staff topped with a large ivory spiral seashell; three or four crisp flat pale-blue water-wave magic currents with fine ink lines curl around him and converge upward into the seashell staff. Pure vivid crimson-vermilion red is used ONLY on his tied cloth waist sash and narrow shoulder cape ribbons; no large gold areas. Walking pose facing right. Complete centered subject with generous transparent padding. Readable at 80px. True transparent alpha background, including gaps. No paper, scenery, ground shadow, glow, background halo, text, border or watermark. Single asset, not a sheet. Red accents will be recolored blue; keep skin, wood and other materials out of the red range.
postprocess: Converted white JPG background (including enclosed gaps >= 500px) to true transparent alpha with edge color decontamination, and centered onto 1280x1280 RGBA canvas (85% fill).
